namespace Geometry.Events
{
    public class ShapeEventArgs : EventArgs
    {
        public Shape Source { get; }
        public ShapeEventArgs(Shape source) => Source = source;
    }

    public class Publisher<TArgs> : IPublisher where TArgs : EventArgs, new()
    {
        public event EventHandler<TArgs> Raised;
        public event EventHandler? Simple, Other;
        public event ShapeHandler Custom;
        private event Action Hidden = () => { };
        public event EventHandler Explicit { add { } remove { } }
        public delegate void Inner(TArgs args);

        protected virtual void OnRaised(TArgs args) => Raised?.Invoke(this, args);
        public void Fire() { OnRaised(new TArgs()); Custom(null, null); }
    }

    public class Sub : Publisher<ShapeEventArgs>
    {
        protected override void OnRaised(ShapeEventArgs args) { base.OnRaised(args); }
        public new void Fire() { }
    }
}
